cards.t: Kava Lend Loses $3.8 Million in Hack
cards.b: Kava Lend suffered a hack resulting in the loss of approximately $3.8 million, causing the KAVA token price to drop nearly 40%.

per.KAVA: Faced severe downward pressure following a $3.8 million exploit on Kava Lend.
